annotations.title: Get the Homejourney owner listing checklist

description: Use this first when an owner wants to sell or rent out their own home on Homejourney, before asking them anything. Returns every field to collect (required or optional, allowed values, examples, which apply only to HDB, condo, landed or rentals), the photo rules, where to order a floor plan, the HDB and URA letting rules (rentalRules) to check with a landlord before collecting the rental details, with the HDB ones in ruleGroups by what is let (the whole flat, rooms, or every HDB rental), and the steps in order: the agent saves the details with create_listing_draft, then the owner adds photos or confirms the ones you add, verifies with Singpass, joins Homejourney Pro and publishes. Ask the owner for all required fields in one message. Needs no sign-in.
name: get_owner_listing_checklist
title: Get the Homejourney owner listing checklist
